# Greenfield Recorder

> > A regional job board and classifieds platform serving Greenfield, MA and surrounding communities with employment listings and local marketplace services.

Greenfield Recorder operates as a digital extension of the local newspaper, providing job search and classifieds services for the Greenfield, Massachusetts area and neighboring towns. The platform aggregates employment opportunities and community listings across western Massachusetts and southern Vermont.

## Key Topics

- Job Search
- Career Advice
- Employment Listings
- Local Classifieds
- Resume Tips

## Jobs & Employment

- [Job Search Platform](https://jobs.recorder.com/): Job search platform with 2M+ listings and career tools
- [Job Categories](https://jobs.recorder.com/job-categories): Browse job categories and local employment in Greenfield, MA area

## Local Classifieds & Community

- [Local Classifieds](https://local.recorder.com/): Local classifieds for Greenfield, MA and regional communities
